analysis: task-derived credit capture and projected branch-model learning

data_join.target_eligibility: DANDI scan plus directly connected, functionally imaged excitatory partners; seven of eight pilot targets qualified
operational_checks: exactly one postsynaptic target in each extract
at least five mapped partners for the functional-topology screen
at least two sites after any requested task filter
at least one nonempty inhibitory ancestry route
data_join.scan_selection_boundary: the archive does not record a deterministic rule for selecting among multiple eligible scans of the same target

dandi_extraction.response: mean RoiResponseSeries fluorescence from trial start_time through stop_time
dandi_extraction.note: The task-derived branch model uses responses and condition-hash stimulus IDs; it does not use the exported stimulus-feature bank.

contact_assignment.dominant_segment_rule: largest summed synapse size, then largest synapse count
contact_assignment.major_branch_rule: first segment below the soma on the dominant segment's ancestry chain
contact_assignment.multiple_contacts: all mapped contacts contribute to partner-level total size and synapse count; one activity feature and one modeled site are assigned to the dominant segment

functional_topology.functional_similarity: Pearson correlation between partners' vectors of mean raw fluorescence over condition identities with at least two trials
functional_topology.repeat_reliability: Spearman correlation between per-condition means from alternating first and second occurrences of each repeated condition, computed separately per ROI
partial_rank_controls: rank(log1p(absolute difference in soma path length in micrometers))
functional_topology.partial_rank_residualization: ordinary least-squares residuals from separate regressions of ranked response and predictor on an intercept and both ranked controls; reported effect is their Pearson correlation
functional_topology.replication_unit: postsynaptic target cell; pairwise partner comparisons are not independent replicates

split_and_scaling.standardization: column-wise training mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1), applied to train and test

feedback.dense_oracle: top right singular vectors of exact training-site error
feedback.random_control: uniform sample without replacement from nonempty inhibitory ancestry routes
feedback.shuffle_control: independent row permutation within every selected morphology column
feedback.depth_control: quantile bins of contact path length
feedback.projection_scope: site-error field used only for input-weight gradients
feedback.exact_updates: branch-readout weights and bias use their exact gradients in every method

inference.tests: two-sided paired Wilcoxon across target means and target-stratified method-label permutation
